text:
𝗥𝗔𝗛𝗨𝗟 𝗜𝗦 𝗦𝗘𝗡𝗔 𝗞𝗜𝗡𝗚! 🇮🇳

KL Rahul now has Test hundreds in all 4 SENA countries - only the 2nd Asian after Saeed Anwar.
India 239/1 at lunch, trail NZ by 129.

#INDvNZ #TeamIndia

facebook.caption:
𝗥𝗔𝗛𝗨𝗟 𝗞𝗔 𝗦𝗘𝗡𝗔 𝗥𝗘𝗖𝗢𝗥𝗗! 🇮🇳🔥

👉 KL Rahul ke naam ab Test shatak chaaron SENA deshon mein
👉 Saeed Anwar ke baad doosre Asian batter
👉 Wellington mein India 239/1 (lunch, Day 3), NZ ke 368 se 129 peeche
👉 Padikkal ne 98 gend mein fifty jadi

Rahul ko kitne number do? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #INDvNZ #TeamIndia
